configuration_role: declarative experiment specification; CLI flags are authoritative
initialization: all learned values from scratch; retain released graph and interface

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: cosine to zero separately per phase; preserve Adam moments across phases

checkpoint_selection.secondary: maximum validation top-1 accuracy; retain actual weights and selection receipt

claim_scope: All three tasks jointly through one encoder, one decoder and one 2,994-output space, on a shared brain with frozen synapses, with sentiment pooled over the sequence. The capacity question at N=3.
test_policy: deferred until comparison and final protocol are fixed
comparison_baseline: I32rank64fixed10k for language; chess-baselines-v1.json for chess; sentiment-baselines-v1.json for sentiment
initialization_note: Same from-scratch trainer initialization and seed42; preserve encoder and neuron initialization. Rank64 changes readout shapes and initial logit variance relative to rank128; verify rank64-specific gradients and optimizer updates before training.
prerequisites: Confirm no competing GPU worker on macm3
Training corpus is a strict superset of the 1,000-story set; validation, test and audit rows are byte-identical

shared: the per-neuron gain, rec_gain and bias
brain.in_proj, the injection both tasks use
the LayerNorm, the rank-64 trunk and the output head
unified.router: a two-way probe on the trunk; supervised, but never gates the output
unified.note: Language recipe, schedule, corpus, seed and 16,800-update budget identical to I32rank64fixed10k. Carries the learned per-task cue and a three-lane router. Sentiment is read as a masked mean of the settled state over the sequence's real positions, so the classifier sees the whole sentence rather than what a leak-0.9 recurrence still remembers at its final token.
